hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A buy/sell hook deducting a 4% fee per swap: ETH fees from buys accumulate in a burn pot for buyback-and-burn via the pool; token fees from sells queue for burning. Pool init and liquidity addition are one-time per token; exact-output swaps always revert. Sells can be gated by an admin allowlist (timeBased/hasValue): any address can activate the restriction per token via pitchWC(), after which only deployer-allowlisted addresses can sell, and only the deployer can deactivate it.
